Living CI for Active Deals

Static battlecards are dead. This lab generates dynamic, deal-specific competitive intelligence that sales can use immediately:

  • TL;DR — 3 bullets max: what sales MUST know for tomorrow's call
  • What's Changed — Recent competitor moves
  • Their Current Pitch — How they're positioning against you
  • Landmines — Objections to expect
  • Trap-Setting Questions — Reframe the conversation in your favor
